character_description: Prometheus, titan bearing marks of eternal suffering—chains, scars, unbowed spirit. Luminous golden skin despite punishment, hair that seems to contain embers, golden eyes reflecting both compassion and revolutionary defiance. His form embodies resistance to unjust authority.

theme: Righteous rebellion against oppressive power for sake of those not allowed to flourish
